column1: # [OPUS-4.8] DBPSB per-commit expected result sizes (count mode = solution count).
# Differential check: on the FIXED 750k-triple cut of the pinned DBpedia slice
# (bench/dbpsb/fetch.sh 750000 — see bench/dbpsb/README.md for URL+sha256), each query's
# solution count is deterministic (verified identical across repeated runs), so a row-count
# drift = a correctness regression. Format: <query>\t<rows>. Wired into scripts/ci-bench.sh
# (dbpsb hook) as a HARD equality check on count mode (latency stays trend-only).
# Heavy-tier queries (h01/h02) live in queries-heavy/ for the EC2/nightly tier, not here.
